reply.text:
Rough stretch at work is exactly when a lighter schedule earns its keep. Three days a week is a good target, and I'll build it around that so you're not fighting your calendar.

Tell me what you're after, whether that's strength, general fitness or just keeping the habit alive, and which days you can actually get to the gym. Then hit Build it and we'll set up three sessions that fit. If the week gets worse, we can drop to two without it being a failure.
